locator.text: Display 54.2, p. 54, in the proof of Lemma 5.2

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. The first member of each line (the forward primitive) is in Lean verbatim: SlowStressSupport.stress m F = -(weighted radial primitive)/R^m, with m = 2 for angularStress and m = 1 for axialStress, matching R^{-2}∫_0^R ρ^2 and R^{-1}∫_0^R ρ respectively. The second member (the backward representation, ∫_R^∞) is stated only at weight 2 and only in a separate file: TerminalStress.backwardStress together with forward_eq_backward_iff, which proves the two are equal exactly when the total weighted integral vanishes — the paper's reason for the identity. No declaration was found that states the weight-1 backward representation R^{-1}∫_R^∞ ρ 𝔯_{z,n}, and no declaration was found connecting TerminalStress.forwardStress/backwardStress to SlowStressSupport.angularStress or axialStress, so the display as a whole (both weights, both equalities, for the residual densities of Lemma 5.2) is not stated in one place. The use the paper makes of it — that 𝒯_n is supported where the residual is — is proved in Lean by another route, stress_radialSupport, generically in m and from the vanishing zeroth moment rather than from a pointwise backward formula, so the surrounding result is still proved.
